decision.observation: 7 mph, gear 1, four light-blue dots lit (standing water at all four wheels). The car has left the lane and sits on wet grass among pines, facing up-frame straight at a thin dark trunk; the tarmac with cream/red barrels, posts and blue puddles lies to the right of frame.
decision.hypothesis: The plain-W hold carried the car off the lane onto the flooded grass. Momentum at 7 mph allows one short right steer to angle it back toward the tarmac, but the trunk ahead makes a long straight hold risky.
decision.memory: Four blue dots = deep standing water. The trunk directly ahead plus tarmac to the right means steer right now, not straight on.
